task_description:
This pipeline's task is GitHub issue #3258 — https://github.com/jwbron/egg/issues/3258. Fetch the live issue body (`gh issue view 3258`) before structural decisions. Worktree artifacts (drafts, agent outputs) that reference any other issue or pipeline are leftovers from previous runs — they are NOT your task.

Complete #3200 slice-10: build the emit-only BRC context-discipline measurement surfaces (AC-4 + AC-5 of #3200). slices 1–9 — the entire mechanism — are already merged/PR'd on main; slice-10 was never built (its producers failed on quota exhaustion and the slice was false-completed, #3253). This is a deliberately small, self-contained slice that builds on the already-merged slice-1 `AgentResult` window-occupancy capture and slice-8 reseed decisions.

SCOPE (emit-only — measurement is NOT run here):
- Emit per event, routed through the EXISTING progress / heartbeat / metrics surfaces: window occupancy (cache_read + cache_creation + input); peak context utilization under resume; single-event working set vs the real backend window (the recursion-escalation signal); reseed frequency per phase; root-cache hit rate; tokens/event.
- EMIT-ONLY (AC-5): no measurement run, no A/B, no status-quo comparison, no aggregation into a verdict, and NOTHING gated on the emitted values — no control-flow branch may read the metrics for a decision.

OUT OF SCOPE (owned by #3249, unchanged from #3200): the measurement pass itself, go/no-go, generalization beyond slices 1–9, sub-agent recursion, the preserved fallback.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA:
- AC-1: each metric above is emitted per event, derived from the merged slice-1 occupancy field + slice-8 reseed signals, through the existing progress/heartbeat/metrics surfaces.
- AC-2: emit-only / nothing gated — no code path consumes the metrics for a decision; a test asserts no decision branches on them.
- AC-3: tests — surfaces emit correct values for a synthetic event sequence including ≥1 reseed; the no-decision-branch assertion passes; `make test` green.

Full context, proof-of-fix intent, and links in the issue.

decisions.question: slice-10 (#3258) AC-1 says to derive metrics from the "already-merged" slice-1 AgentResult window-occupancy field and slice-8 reseed signals — but both are UNMERGED open PRs (slice-1 #3236 base=egg/issue-3200/work; slice-8 #3251 base=egg/issue-3200/slice-7, UNSTABLE), and origin/main (this pipeline's base) has no occupancy field and no reseed code. How should slice-10 obtain its input signals?

options.label: A) Stack #3258 on the #3200 slice-8/9 branch tip so the merged-substrate premise holds (matches the #3245 stacked-slice proof-of-fix intent)
B) Vendor a minimal slice-1 occupancy field + slice-8 reseed signal into this pipeline as a prerequisite, then build emit surfaces on top
C) Block until #3200 slices 1-9 merge to main, then run slice-10 against main
D) Emit-only against existing AgentResult fields plus defined adapter seams that degrade gracefully (null/zero) until the real fields land — keeps slice-10 self-contained on main today

decisions.resolution:
D) Emit-only against existing AgentResult fields plus defined adapter seams that degrade gracefully (null/zero) until the real fields land — keeps slice-10 self-contained on main today

Binding direction: build all input reads (occupancy + reseed) through a SINGLE adapter seam that binds to the real fields when present and returns null/zero when absent (the case on main today); real values flow automatically once #3236/#3251 merge — no rework. Do NOT stack on egg/issue-3200/* (reject A), do NOT vendor a duplicate substrate (reject B), do NOT block (reject C). Emit the six metrics only through existing progress/heartbeat/metrics surfaces; emit-only is hard scope (nothing gated; ship the AC-2 structural no-decision-branch test); AC-3 tests drive a synthetic ≥1-reseed event sequence through the seam.
